reviews.text: My cavalier king charles spaniel has been coming to the BLDHTX for 13 years! They have always taken amazing care of him from daycare, to boarding and grooming. Now he is a senior boy and we still send him to BLDHTX for boarding and grooming. He is comfortable, happy, and most importantly well cared for. He has a heart condition and is currently on four different medications and  that are administered four times daily. His medication protocol is complex and constantly changing but BLDHTX takes the time to learn the schedule and administers everything perfectly. We trust them implicitly with both of our dogs, but especially our senior boy. Thank you BLDHTX for being so amazing with our dogs and treating them like family. We appreciate all that you do!

My favorite, FAVORITE doggie daycare in all of Houston! I've been taking my bostons here for seven years now and can't recommend them enough. I've used both their daycare and grooming services and I'm always happy with the results. They do the cutest photoshoots and dog events. My dogs are always excited when I drop them off for the day and so sleepy when they come back home. I know they're in good hands at Best Little Dog House!

The Best Little Dog House truly lives up to its name! I’ve been taking my dog here for over 10 years, and they have always been absolutely wonderful. The staff is so kind, caring, and genuinely loves the dogs they take care of. It means so much to have a place I’ve trusted with my girl for all these years. She’s always well cared for, and I know she’s in great hands whenever she’s there. I can’t recommend them enough!
Hi Britt, thanks for the great rating!

We absolutely LOVE The Best Little Dog House! They have been caring for our sweet Teddy Graham for the past 3 years, and we couldn’t be happier with the love, care, and attention he receives every time he stays.

The staff is truly amazing, caring, and compassionate. You can tell they genuinely love the dogs they care for, and that gives us such peace of mind knowing Teddy is in wonderful hands. ❤️🐾

And Kerry, the owner, is absolutely wonderful! She goes above and beyond to make sure every dog is happy, safe, and well cared for. Her dedication and love for the dogs really shine through.

Teddy Graham is always excited to go, and that says everything! We are so grateful to have found a place we can trust completely. If you’re looking for a loving, caring, and trustworthy home away from home for your fur baby, we highly recommend The Best Little Dog House!

Thank you, Kerry and the entire team, for loving and caring for Teddy Graham like he’s one of your own! 🐶❤️ Brittney & Teddy Graham Carter

We’ve been coming here for over 8 years, and the love they show our babies has always meant so much to us.  Teddy absolutely loves it here and is always such a happy boy! Knowing he’s loved and well taken care of gives me such peace of mind.

Winston is always happy to go to BLDTX. The staff is loving, the foyer is clean, the dogs are temperament tested. There is outdoor and indoor time by group.

The owner contacts you if she is concerned about the health of your dog and takes steps to mitigate any problems, such as applying salve to a sore paw.

BLDHTX has great hours: M-F 7/7, SA 9/5, Sun 11/5, which is helpful for single pup parents & working folk. Takes the stress out of pick ups!

Holiday portraits are offered for a small fee.

Finally, they offer cage-free boarding, with humans present 24/7. Our well-loved boy wouldn't tolerate being in a box 12 hours a day, and would be very frightened if there were a storm (and he would be much worse if he was with barking dogs & no human present). During boarding, you receive daily photos and rapid responses to any queries or concerns. Bathing is offered before pick up.

They have thought of everything!

I have been taking my little dog here for about four years now to be full groomed. Over many years interacting with many people I have yet to have even a slightly bad experience. They keep notes to make sure my dog is groomed to perfection every time. Could not recommend enough!!!

We absolutely love best little dog house. We’ve been taking Winston for daycare and grooming for the past 7 years and appreciate the love, care, and attention they give our sweet angel baby. Grooming is always on point. The groomers always listen to what we want and he comes home smelling fresh!

I have been bringing my maltipoo here for boarding for years. BLDHTX is the best place ever and I don't know what I would do without them! My pup is now 15 and they are so sweet and patient with him and his changing needs. They do an amazing job of making sure all of the dogs are comfortable and happy. I love that they offer grooming here so when I pick him up from boarding he is nice and clean. The owners and all the staff are very communicative and friendly. I wouldn't trust my pup anywhere else, can't recommend them enough!

Obsessed with The Best Little Dog House in Texas !!!! My mom takes our family dog here and he has the time of his life every day. I don't even live in Houston but I needed to share that Ollie's photoshoots are the best part of my day !!! I live for the constant Instagram updates, seeing all of the puppies running around and having fun. If I ever move back to Houston, I will definitely be bringing my own dogs here :)

I have been bringing my King Charles cavalier here since he was a tiny 12 week old puppy. I wanted to socialize him as well as not leave him home all day alone while we were at work. Best little dog house was the only place that I visited that I felt was safe (small dogs only) and had the cage free and sweet atmosphere I was looking for. My dog is turning 10 this year and we have only taken him here for daycare, grooming and boarding since day 1. The owner and staff here love every dog like it was their own. The facilities are immaculately cleaned, grooming has always been a great experience, I feel safe boarding my furst baby here always as well. We live in the heights and when we get close to Best Little Dog House my dog knows and gets sooo excited for his visits. I could not recommended this place more. We are big fans for the last 10 years!

My Penny girl and I love BLDHTX! She has gone for 4 years now since she was a puppy. It’s nice that the dogs are close to her size and they do  temperament testing for all dogs. I board Penny here when needed and it brings me lots of comfort knowing that she isn’t locked in a cage. I know she’s in good hands with the employees. I also get her a bath on her last day of boarding and she comes home smelling and looking good with cute, new bandanas each time and a report card with the condition of her skin/fur/ears, etc. They also do fun enrichment activities for the doggos and hilarious photoshoots, if you’d like to purchase. I get multiple picture updates and get to see my girl on their instagram while I am out of town!  She has never come home sick either which I appreciate. I have tried many places due to moving, but BLDHTX is the best experience Penny and I have had with doggy daycare/boarding/grooming services in the Houston area. It’s worth it!!
My little guy is so timid and anti social yet he always comes back happy after a grooming. ❤️

My baby, Tre, has been going here since he was 6 months old. At first, for daycare, but aged out since he isn’t neutered 😩 but he would run allllll day and have the best time, then come home to eat and knock out… the good ol’ days! Anyway, he now only comes for grooming and is now 4 years old. I highly recommend 💕
This is the only place I’ll leave my fur child.

Lots of love for BLDHTX!

I was looking for a place where Bandit could socialize, burn off some energy, and have fun while I work. Since moving from the suburbs to Midtown, he had become pretty reactive to people walking by.

After starting at BLDHTX, I noticed positive changes. He is more comfortable around people, and I really credit the amazing and sweet staff and positive environment they create!

I also love seeing the Instagram stories throughout the day and watching Bandit in the mix with his little dog friends. Most importantly, he loves going in and happily greets the staff at check-in.

Grateful to have found BLDHTX and highly recommend!

I have been bringing Gallagher to the Best Litte Dog House for 4 years, and my second rescue dog has been going for the past 6 months. We've had nothing but wonderful experiences!
I feel completely comfortable leaving my boys with this amazing team, even when I travel overseas. Knowing they are safe, loved and well cared for gives me incredible peace of mind.
Highly recommend this wonderful team!

I took my dog to Best Little Dog House from the time I got her until I moved out of state. We took advantage of their grooming services, daycare and boarding. My dog would get very excited when we pulled up and she would eagerly go inside. I appreciated that it is cage-free, extremely clean and well run. They genuinely care about their clients and their pets.

Finding trustworthy and heartfelt care especially when traveling can be stressful but I truly trust the care at BLDHTX. I’ve taken three dogs here and they’ve done training, boarding, and daycare (as shown by the many photos!).

They know my dogs by name the second I walk through the door and have worked with my special needs dogs: one was three legged and partially blind and another has a cleft palate. They administer medication as needed and always work to meet a dog’s needs for an enjoyable stay.

If you have a dog under 35 lbs, this is THE place. All the photoshoots and enrichments are amazing, but I love knowing my dog is safe, out of a cage, happy, and loved while I’m away.

My dog, Pepper has been doing daycare, boarding, and grooming at BLDHTX since 2020. My dog, Cinnamon has been doing daycare, boarding, and groom here since 2022. My 3rd dog, Tilly also does daycare here. I can always trust them to care for my dogs when I'm away on trips. Every penny is worth it for the peace of mind knowing they're in good hands. Even with the amount of dogs they care for, it's so nice to know that they know my girls by name.

Shoutout to their groomers Sab and Christina who always make Pepper and Cinnamon smell so good and look so pretty. Cinnamon can be a little particular so Sab has learned Cinny so well and knows just how to groom in a way that doesn't bother her.

I've hosted multiple birthday parties for Pepper and Cinnamon at BLDHTX and they had a blast celebrating their special day. The pictures are always incredible. They also love to go on photoshoot days to get themed pictures and doing arts and crafts or drinking bone broth margaritas.

All in all, I can't say enough positive words about BLDHTX and wouldn't trust anyone else with daycare, boarding, and grooming all in one.

My Shiba Inu, Fox, always has the best time with Sabrina at his monthly grooming session. The staff is so friendly and accommodating. They also have great response times. Thank you BLDH for always being great.

I absolutely love this place. I have two shitzu one which has been going since she was 12 weeks whom is 9 now . Another that’s been going since he was adopted at 1. My 9 year old dog has grown up to be a bit of handful when it comes to being over excited when a dog enters a room. The best little dog house has always pay special attention to her to make sure she feels safe and the other dogs feel safe . Both of my dogs have had many sleepovers and they get groomed there every two months. I never write reviews but I love this place so much I want everyone  to know how awesome they are from grooming to overall care the give the dogs!
As soon as he was fully vaccinated I started taking Moose for puppy kindergarten, and everyone gushes how well behaved he is.

My fur baby means everything to me, and I'm very particular about his care and who I trust to watch him--especially because he is blind and developed anxiety after he lost his vision. The team at BLDHTX is incredible with him--and I know because Charlie absolutely LOVES going to "camp!" So much so, that he literally tries to jump straight out of the car as soon as I open the door when we arrive--and he can't even jump on/off the sofa anymore since losing his sight! It's a gift to know he's in great hands when I'm away--whether he's there for day care or to board for a few nights. Thank you, BLDHTX!

Love The Best Little Dog House. The staff is so kind to me and my dog. My dog is not super playful, so it is comforting to know that she is spending time outside with other dogs and being loved on by the awesome employees. Definitely recommend daycare!

We've been going to BLDHTX since our 10 year-old goldendoodle Bela was 3 months old. Kerry and Luke (the owners) actually came to our house when she was a pup to train her, and we've been with them ever since.  Bela gets so excited when she gets to go visit for grooming or boarding--it's a special treat for her! They truly love animals there and will take wonderful care of your fur baby- you can trust them completely.

I love the Best Little Dog House! They’re so accommodating with my dog who absolutely hates the vet/ groomer due to anxiety. He can be difficult in those environments but Sabrina treats him with such care! Will be a forever customer!
My little baby is always so excited to go to school & he loves it here as do I! Great place, great staff, I couldn’t recommend it enough!!

Always takes care of Milo! His photoshoots, enrichments, and daily activities always make him wore out when he comes home after a long day! Always keeping us updated and post the dogs so we can see what they are up to. 10/10 recommend!!

We absolutely love BLDHTX! ❤️ Moey has been going there for over 3 years, and we couldn’t be happier with the love and care he receives. As a senior dog, it gives me such peace of mind knowing he is happy, safe, and genuinely loved by the staff. He always gets so excited to go! 🐾

Thank you, BLDHTX, for taking such wonderful care of our sweet Moey. We highly recommend you! ❤️

My dog and I love BLD. He goes to daycare regularly and has also boarded multiple times. He's very friendly with dogs and people but also very very shy/nervous and needs a lot of time to warm up. He is so comfortable here, though! He pulls at his leash when we arrive and runs right up to staff and the door back to the daycare area. Staff greet him by name and are always happy to see him. And they're always attentive - they reached out to me once during a longer boarding stay when they noticed he had lost some weight to make sure it was addressed. I'm so grateful to have a place I can trust that he also loves.

We have used BLDHTX since moving back to Houston 4 years ago. We feel confident leaving our dog with them, knowing she's in good hands. The staff is friendly and caring and the facility is safe and clean. I highly recommend them for anyone looking for a place where their dog will be treated like family.

Best Little Dog House is the best for grooming! My poor anxious Max really struggles with grooming- to the point that PetCo refused to groom him this summer when we were out of town for two months. Sabrina is so gentle with Max and he has always been able to complete his grooming (4 + years). I’m so grateful to have such a wonderful and talented place to get him groomed in the neighborhood.

I have been bringing Monty to BLDHTX for grooming for over 5 years now! Have always had a great experience here. Before I moved into the city, I used to make a 45min-1hr drive just to drop Monty off for grooming for over 3 years! It’s been a pleasure in putting my trust in BLDHTX to take care of Monty well🥰

BLDH has been wonderful for us. They are very responsive and caring. Recently, they were very communicative and professional when something came up with our little guy, Bowie. They went above and beyond to help him out. We look forward to continuing to use BLDH. Highly recommend.

My dog Annie and I adore BLDHTX! You know a dog loves going when they get excited in the parking lot and run straight to the staff members when we walk in:) I love seeing the updates on instagram throughout the day and she's all worn out when she gets home which is great! Annie had boarded here also, and we love that there's no crates and the dogs have a big sleepover together!
The stuffs are very dog and human friendly!

We love BLD! My Dachshund, Penny, has been going to daycare here for 5 years now and this is the only place I’ve ever boarded her when I can’t take her with me on vacations.

Penny is always happy to go inside the building, which is a huge indicator for me that she has a good time here. She has never shown any fear or hesitation (like she does at the vet) and that means she’s had nothing but positive experiences!

The facility is so nice and well-equipped – Penny’s favorite part is probably the refrigerated plate in the play yard.

Penny gets groomed here as well and it’s so nice to be able to pick her up from a boarding stay and have her soft and smelling fresh!

The photoshoots they do are adorable and there are always fun enrichment activities going on for the dogs.

I tell everyone I know about BLD and how much we love this place and the staff!

I’ve had such a wonderful experience with Best Little Dog House! Quincy has been coming here for grooming, daycare, and training, and the entire team has always been caring, professional, and genuinely invested in his well-being.

The training has made a noticeable difference in his behavior, and it’s been so rewarding to see his confidence and skills grow.

I love the fun photo shoots and birthday parties!

I absolutely love Best Little Dog House! Cooper has been coming here for over four years, and I wouldn’t trust anyone else with him. The entire staff is incredibly kind, welcoming, and truly cares about every dog that walks through the door.

A special thank you to Cris! Cooper always looks amazing after every grooming appointment, and one of the things I appreciate most is that he’s never nervous about going. That gives me so much peace of mind knowing he’s comfortable and in such caring hands.

Thank you to everyone at Best Little Dog House for taking such wonderful care of my sweet boy over the years. I truly appreciate all of you and highly recommend Best Little Dog House to anyone looking for a grooming team that genuinely cares about your pet. 🐾❤️

My Shih Tzu princess Saint has been going here for almost three years for daycare, boarding, and grooming, and I truly cannot say enough good things about them. She suffers from separation anxiety, and the staff has always been so patient, gentle, and loving with her.
I also love all the fun enrichment activities they plan, from margaritas, ball play days, photoshoots and even charcuterie boards and brunch! They keep her engaged, spoiled, and happy, and provide daily updates, which keeps me at ease when she's there.  The facilities are always clean and their pricing is also reasonable, especially considering the level of care they provide.
They also do an excellent job grooming her making sure she's ready to step out in true diva style, even though Saint is not a fan of the bows I insist they add lol.
Saint is truly like my child, so knowing she is with people who genuinely care about her means everything to me. I highly recommend them!

I’ve been taking Nico to BLDHTX for the past 8 years, and absolutely love them! ❤️ They’ve always taken such great care of Nico, from grooming to doggie care, and I always feel comfortable knowing he’s in good hands.
The staff is friendly, caring, and truly treats the dogs like their own. Nico is always well taken care of, and I couldn’t be happier with the service and the love they show him every time he visits.

After 8 years, I can honestly say I wouldn’t trust anyone else with Nico! 🐾❤️ Highly recommend BLDHTX to anyone looking for a place where their dogs are genuinely loved and cared for!

Our Mini loves BLDHTX. She lights up as soon as we turn the corner. Jumps out of our hands and into staff's hands every time. They do a great job at grooming and she burns off all of her energy every time! Lots of enrichments and pampering if you want them! 100% recommend them!

We love the Best Little Dog House and have sent our dogs here for 9 years(!) for daycare, grooming and occasional overnight stays, starting back when they were at their much smaller facility. We have always been impressed with the staff, who clearly love the dogs and our sweet girls. It's such a great option for smaller dogs who might get overrun at facilities with much bigger dogs, and we are so grateful this place exists. It's a gem!

We love everything about BLDHTX!! My dog rushes inside to play with his friends, is not afraid of grooming any more and had not issues spending the night! The staff exudes love for the fury friends they interact with daily. I highly recommend BLDHTX!

We love this place. We have been taking our Teddy Bear dog to BLDHTX for grooming for over four years. he always looks adorable, and he loves going there! We are so happy with the all the groomers and staff. We recommend BLDH to everyone who has a little dog who needs grooming or day care. They are the best!

We’ve trusted BLDHTX with our dogs for more than 10 years. The staff is wonderful, and our pups always come home happily exhausted ("daycare wasted") after daycare. We love planning visits around the fun themed activities and photo shoots.

One of our dogs gets anxious when she's away from her housemate, and Kerry has been incredibly helpful in making daycare a more positive experience for her.

We also use the grooming services, and the dogs always come home looking and smelling great. We’ve recommended BLDHTX to many friends and will continue to do so.

My dog has been coming to BLD since she was a puppy, and now at 7 years old, it’s still the only place I trust with her. Whether it’s grooming or boarding, the staff consistently goes above and beyond to take amazing care of her. She always comes home happy, clean, and clearly well-loved.

The team here truly cares about the animals — you can tell they treat every pet like their own.

The Best Little Dog House in Texas is one of the best decisions I have made for Pop Tart. Seriously.

I adopted her from BARC about a month before she started attending BLDH in July 2025. We were still getting to know each other, I was potty training her and I had no idea how she would do with other dogs. She was also scared of living in downtown Houston. A stranger at a dog park recommended BLDH, so I gave it a try after hearing horror stories about small dogs at doggy daycares that take big and small dogs.

More than a year later, Pop Tart gets excited the moment I say the word “school.” She knows exactly where we are going, guides me to the front door of BLDH and greets the staff before heading back to play. Every time! She now has the confidence to play with dogs of all sizes and comes home exhausted and happy.

Pop Tart has used daycare, boarding, grooming and training. Angel’s leash training helped her learn to walk for miles, sit, lie down and stay, while also teaching me how to redirect her. Cris, one of the grooomers, has even helped her learn to enjoy bath time.

The communication and care are exceptional. The team sends photos, calls when Pop Tart has tummy trouble or gets herself into mischief and knows her personality well. They have also accommodated last-minute boarding when work emergencies came up. Online booking is easy, the activity calendar helps me plan ahead and their social media updates are genuinely useful.

I especially appreciate that BLDH is locally owned, cage-free and designed with city dogs in mind. The dogs have indoor and outdoor play areas and even sleep on beds when boarding. I do not trust anyone else to care for Pop Tart when I am away.

These are dog lovers who get paid to love our dogs, and it shows. I mean, they have ice cream parties, pool days, photos and birthday parties. Story time. Snuffle mat time.

I'm not kidding: scroll through my photos and see how excited Pop Tart is at a school and in the car... on the way to school.

My puppy Penny has been going to The Best Little Dog House for over a year, and she absolutely loves it. The staff are caring, attentive, and treat every dog like family. We’ve used their daycare, boarding, training, and grooming services, and every experience has been outstanding. Their training program has helped Penny build confidence and great habits, and I always have peace of mind knowing she’s in such good hands. If you’re looking for a trusted daycare, boarding, training, or grooming facility in Houston, I highly recommend The Best Little Dog House.

We have been bringing our dog Ozzie to Best Little Dog House for six years now. He came for the first time when he was a little over 6 months old and we had such a great expereince we never went anywhere else for boarding or daycare. The thoughtful nature of the space itself and the incredible staff really set this place apart. They are professional and kind, and all seem to truly care about the dogs and their humans!

Additionally, Ozzie has severe food allergy so it has been wonderful being able to trust that the staff at Best Little Dog House will take care of him well and ensure that he doesn't come into contact with anything he shouldn't while he's there. The cage free nature of the boarding setup in particular is welcome as he is not used to sleeping in a kennel and prefers being cuddled up in a blanket with a trusted human nearby.

It's such a relief to know that when he is at Best Little Dog House he is having a great time and being well treated. He loses his mind with excitement when we tell him he is getting to "go play!" and always eagerly runs to the front door when he gets out of the car!

If you are looking for a small dog focused daycare and boarding facility in the Montrose area, look no further than Best Little Dog House!
This place is the absolute best! They care for the pups like they’re their own! If you’re deciding where to leave your loved furry one, you’ll have a great experience here!

They are professional and friendly, and always know my dog’s name. The day care is convenient and I know my dog is able to run around or sit still while not being in a cage, whew. The grooming is perfect!  My 7 lbs little dog, initially would not allow anyone to brush her, they reported to me her behavior, she was a screamer and biter,  yet they did not kick her out (as another groomer did) and patiently got her to calm down and now she has no problem and always comes through looking gorgeous!!!
I took chewy to petco for grooming and he hated it we tried the best little dog house and he has since loved it they are very patient with him he even tried daycare for the first time

Finding a daycare and boarding facility for a special needs dog is incredibly challenging, so discovering The Best Little Dog House in Texas has been such a relief.

My two girls absolutely love coming here, and I have complete peace of mind knowing they’re in great hands. My sweet Chloe has special needs (paralyzed), and it’s been extremely difficult to find a place that could truly accommodate her. Kerry and her team have gone above and beyond to make sure Chloe receives the care, attention, and accommodations she needs while treating her like family.

I also love that both of my girls get plenty of socialization, playtime, and enrichment in a safe, loving environment. It’s rare to find a team that is not only professional and dependable but also genuinely cares about every dog that walks through their doors.

I can’t recommend The Best Little Dog House in Texas enough. If you’re looking for daycare or boarding especially if your dog has special needs - this is the place. Thank you, Kerry and your amazing team, for loving my girls like they’re your own!

For our family, The Best Little Dog House is hands down the best! Our sweet Sadie has been attending both doggy daycare and boarding there for the past nine years, and our newest pup, Noodles, has been part of the BLDH family since last year. Both of our dogs are groomed there, and Noodles also completed her training with their wonderful team.

Whether it’s daycare, an overnight stay, or an extended boarding stay of up to 2½ weeks while we’re traveling, we have complete peace of mind knowing our dogs are in loving, capable hands. The staff truly cares about every dog and treats them like family.

One thing we appreciate most is their communication. They always keep us informed about how our pups are doing, and if they notice anything that seems off, they’re proactive and reach out right away. That level of attentiveness and care is priceless.

We can’t recommend BLDH enough. Thank you for taking such incredible care of Sadie and Noodles over the years - we’re so grateful to have found you!

I am very happy to have been referred to Best little dog house. Gadget  has special needs and Sabrina has best the person ever to work with him. Gadget suffers from severe anxiety and fear and has to be medicated to do his grooms. Sabrina you always deliver . Thank you for your patience and kindness with my fur baby. Thank you for genuinely being happy to see Gadget when we show up and ready for the task lol. I’m so grateful for you you stepped up to the plate from the very beginning and have been there for him through it all.

I do not work from home so needed a doggy daycare for my new puppy.  I took him here at 14 weeks and he is now 7 months old.  The staff are so kind and friendly and I feel very comfortable leaving him in their care.  He has done 2 levels of training and learned so much.  During training they send you weekly videos and I can tell he just loves learning.  When I watched the training videos and he heard the trainers voice he ran all over looking for her so I think that is a good sign :)  He gets baths and grooming regularly and they do an amazing job.  It is very convenient if your puppy is at daycare because they are groomed and ready to go when you pick them up at the end of the day.  I have also boarded him a couple of times and I feel so much better knowing he is in a familiar place with people and dogs he knows.  They are crate free and he has never been in a crate so that was important to me to find a crate free facility.  They are very communicative of even small things and keep notes throughout the day if you have questions on how your dog did behaviorally or if he ate his lunch, etc.  My dog is a picky eater and most days he has finished his lunch when I pick him up which I know wasn't the easiest task as a lot of times you need to hand feed him for him to finish eating.

I love the Best Little Dog House. This is the only place I trust to board my dogs. You can tell that all the staff really love and care for all of the dogs there. I also love getting daily picture updates. They are also quick to call if there is ever an issue with your pet. Thank you BLDH for taking such great care of my fur babies over the past 7 years.

I've been taking my dog to BLDHTX for the past 7 years, and I wouldn't trust anyone else with her. Even after moving outside of the Houston city limits, I still make the drive because the care they provide is unmatched.

The daily boarding updates they provide give so much peace of mind, and the staff is always quick to reach out if they have any questions or concerns during her stay. It's clear they genuinely care about every dog they look after.

The best proof of how much she loves it is how excited she gets every time we pull into the parking lot. She always comes home happy, well cared for, and tired from all the fun she's had.

I absolutely love BLDHTX and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a daycare or boarding facility they can truly trust!

I need more than 5 stars to describe our experience at BLDHTX. Our puppy loves it there! We are greeted each visit by the knowledgeable and caring staff. We scour their instagram for the day’s funny photos. All in all an excellent experience. Kerry is a magician.

We LOVE this place.  Our Zeus runs to get inside every morning, which is all the affirmation we need that he is happy and in great hands.  We've been doing daycare, grooming, and training here for almost a year, starting with their kindergarten class for our new pup.

We originally enrolled here for short-term training/daycare to get the basics down, but we quickly realized we would not be able to leave.  Our pup is happy and exhausted at the end of each day, so he will keep going to "school" with his friends for the foreseeable future.

The training is fantastic (Zeus loves his teacher, hi Angel!) and includes tons of feedback, written explanations and videos of your pup learning.  And the groomers are gentle and extremely talented--the report cards on bath days are adorable.  The daily activities, insta updates, photo report cards, treats and parties are unbelievably creative and fun (often hilarious)--we live for seeing what these little ones get into every day.

We love our extended family at BLDHTX and are confident in recommending it to everyone we know.  Give them a try, but know that you probably won't be able to leave!

Sophia Dachs and Miss Finley totally love BLDHTX, Houston’s 5-Star doggy daycare/cage free boarding, compassionate grooming and fun training facility that “gets” dachshunds. As soon as I pull into the driveway, they excitedly start saying, “Hurry up and park, Momma! Our teachers a d furriends are waiting for us!” When I open the back door and unfasten their seatbelts, Sophie and Finley almost jump right out of the car! Feb 2025 Update:
A whole 5 years had passed since Teddy had been a regular at BLDHTX. We recently moved back from Washington and of course, the first place I thought to bring Teddy for boarding/ daycare is his old favorite place! We quickly learned things have changed! It’s a new facility with different staff, and different service offerings. Teddy is also a different dog these days. Call it COVID maybe, but Teddy had become a very anxious dog that may have some escape artist tendencies while overall less enthusiastic about playtime. He’s also now 8 yrs. instead of 2 - so there’s a different energy level! Anyway, I have to say that all things together, BLDHTX has been a safe space for Teddy, but I don’t get the sense he’s loved/ cared for in the same way he used to be 🥹. It used to feel like Teddy was a part of the family but it now kind of feels like Teddy is just another dog. As he has been acclimating back into the facility and experiencing high levels of anxiety acknowledged all staff -  so much that he does require 1-2 prescription medications while at boarding/ daycare - I just don’t feel I’m receiving the right level of communication about his behavior both while he’s boarding and when I pick him up. The only communication that was loud and clear was how bad his anxiety was and that if improvements weren’t made he wouldn’t be able to come back. That kind of news was alarming to me but of course I want Teddy to be safe. Since then he’s been on new medication and I have followed the staff’s suggestions to bring him in for daycare, too, to help Teddy adjust better. I just would expect a little bit of communication to update me on how Teddy has been doing as I have been on a journey navigating Teddy’s mental health - it’s been a stressful one!

Additionally, though a smaller issue, Teddy boarded 2 separate times recently and I scheduled a bath/ groom each time (to occur day of pick up). Both times there was some kind of scheduling issue in which Teddy almost didn’t get bathed the first time and actually never did the second time. I now need to take him to a different place the next day to ensure he’s clean.

Overall, not sure how to put my finger on it, but we just don’t feel at home at BLDHTX the way we used to :-(.
